title: Segfault Beneath The Change Operation

labels.name: bug-crash
labels.description: issue reporting a crash or segfault

body:
- `nvim --version`: NVIM v0.2.1-151-gedfe0980 
- Operating system/version: Mac OS
- Terminal name/version: iTerm2 3.0.15
- `$TERM`: screen-256color

### Actual behaviour

Segfault, e.g. backtrace:
```
* thread #1, queue = 'com.apple.main-thread', stop reason = EXC_BAD_ACCESS (code=2, address=0x280d000)
  * frame #0: 0x00007fffe0816bc9 libsystem_platform.dylib`_platform_bzero$VARIANT$Haswell + 41
    frame #1: 0x000000010012dddc nvim`op_yank_reg [inlined] yank_copy_line at ops.c:2537 [opt]
    frame #2: 0x000000010012dd9c nvim`op_yank_reg(oap=0x00007fff5fbfeb58, message=<unavailable>, reg=<unavailable>, append=<unavailable>) at ops.c:2453 [opt]
    frame #3: 0x000000010012d05b nvim`op_delete(oap=0x00007fff5fbfeb58) at ops.c:1409 [opt]
    frame #4: 0x00000001001306c1 nvim`op_change(oap=0x00007fff5fbfeb58) at ops.c:2180 [opt]
    frame #5: 0x000000010011cf4a nvim`do_pending_operator(cap=0x00007fff5fbfebc8, old_col=<unavailable>, gui_yank=<unavailable>) at normal.c:1851 [opt]
    frame #6: 0x000000010012246a nvim`normal_execute [inlined] normal_finish_command(s=<unavailable>) at normal.c:884 [opt]
    frame #7: 0x0000000100122353 nvim`normal_execute(state=0x00007fff5fbfeb28, key=<unavailable>) at normal.c:1140 [opt]
    frame #8: 0x00000001001cf4cf nvim`state_enter(s=0x00007fff5fbfeb28) at state.c:61 [opt]
    frame #9: 0x000000010011c155 nvim`normal_enter(cmdwin=<unavailable>, noexmode=<unavailable>) at normal.c:467 [opt]
    frame #10: 0x00000001000efa8f nvim`main(argc=<unavailable>, argv=<unavailable>) at main.c:556 [opt]
    frame #11: 0x00007fffe0603235 libdyld.dylib`start + 1
    frame #12: 0x00007fffe0603235 libdyld.dylib`start + 1
```

### Expected behaviour

To not crash.

### Steps to reproduce

Requires some vimrc setup:
```viml
" XXX: both setting are required (tabstop defaults to 8 otherwise, and the
" crash doesn't happen... spooky)
set virtualedit=all
set tabstop=4

" NOTE: the mark setting below turns out to be required: I tried removing it
" and performing adjusted edits (i.e. moving back up a line after the 2-line
" MoveSelectionDown), but the crash did not provoke.

function! MoveSelectionDown(count) abort
  normal! m`
  silent! exe "'<,'>move'>+".a:count
  norm! ``
endfunction

xmap ]e :<C-U>call MoveSelectionDown(v:count1)<CR>
```

Then you edit this code and run `5ggJjVj]ece` in normal mode:
```golang
// run the following in normal mode: 5ggJjVj]ece
package main

func foo() error {
	if n, err := bar();
	err != nil {
		return err
	}
	n = n * n
	return nil
}
```

I've tossed that into https://github.com/jcorbin/nvim_bug fwiw.
